scenario.topic: Which streaming service should the flat share subscribe to

options.name: Netflix Standard Plan
options.upside: Offers a wide range of original and licensed content with offline viewing.
options.concern: Allows only two simultaneous streams, which may limit usage among three people.

options.name: Amazon Prime Video
options.upside: Includes three simultaneous streams and access to additional Prime benefits.
options.concern: Content library may have fewer recent releases compared to competitors.

options.name: Disney+ Subscription
options.upside: Supports four simultaneous streams and strong family-friendly content.
options.concern: Content focus is narrower, which might not suit all tastes in the flat.

options.name: Hulu (No Ads) Plan
options.upside: Offers current TV episodes soon after airing and ad-free viewing.
options.concern: Only two simultaneous streams and a higher price may limit group use.

shared_context: A flat share of three people wants to subscribe to a streaming service. They seek a service with a variety of content, simultaneous streams, and a price suitable for shared use.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a tech-savvy professional who values practical features and cost-efficiency in shared subscriptions.
personas.private_goal: To find a streaming service that allows all three flatmates to watch simultaneously without extra cost.

A.reason_for: Offers a wide range of content and offline downloads.
A.reason_against: Only two simultaneous streams limit access for three people.

B.reason_for: Supports three simultaneous streams and includes extra Prime benefits, fitting the flat's needs perfectly.

C.reason_for: Affordable price and four simultaneous streams are attractive for shared use.
C.reason_against: Content is more niche and may not satisfy all tastes.

D.reason_for: Ad-free viewing and current TV shows are nice perks.
D.reason_against: Only two simultaneous streams and higher price make it less suitable for three people.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is an avid movie and TV show enthusiast who appreciates original content and variety.
personas.private_goal: To have access to the most diverse and high-quality content for entertainment.

A.reason_for: Wide range of original and licensed content with offline viewing is ideal for variety.

B.reason_for: Three simultaneous streams and additional Prime benefits add value.
B.reason_against: Content may not be as fresh or varied as Netflix.

C.reason_against: Content focus is too narrow and less appealing for diverse tastes.

D.reason_for: Access to current TV episodes soon after airing and ad-free experience.
D.reason_against: Higher price and limited streams reduce group usability.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe enjoys family-friendly and franchise-based content and values affordability and flexibility.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the service supports multiple users simultaneously and offers content everyone can enjoy.

A.reason_for: Strong content variety and offline downloads.
A.reason_against: Only two streams limit simultaneous use among three flatmates.

B.reason_for: Three simultaneous streams and good content balance.
B.reason_against: Content may be less family-oriented than preferred.

C.reason_for: Four simultaneous streams, affordable price, and strong family-friendly franchises.

D.reason_for: Ad-free and current shows are appealing.
D.reason_against: Limited streams and higher cost reduce suitability.
